title: Scan Barcodes with Python in 3 Steps!

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing OpenCV and pyzbar for barcode scanning.

steps.title: Step 2: Capture Video
steps.explanation: We open the webcam and continuously read video frames.

steps.title: Step 3: Decode and Print
steps.explanation: We decode any barcodes found and print the data to the console.

steps.title: Step 4: Cleanup
steps.explanation: Finally, we release the webcam and close the window.

steps.title: Step 5: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Run the function and point your phone at a barcode!
